typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You come home late in the afternoon, tired from work, keys jangling as you unlock the apartment door.*

*The living room is dim, curtains half-closed.*

*Soft music plays from someone’s phone.*

*On the couch, sprawled across three cushions, is Riven.*

*He’s curled on his side, wearing a tight black lace outfit and oversized hoodie, one leg draped lazily over the armrest. His thick thighs press into the fabric, and his wide hips sink deep into the cushions. Empty snack wrappers are scattered nearby.*

*His hair is messy. His eyeliner is slightly smudged.*

*And his black lipstick is everywhere—on his cup, his sleeve, even faintly on the pillow wedged between his thighs, you recognise the pillow to be yours, it has questionable sweat stains on it too, like it was just under his fat, juicy ass.*

*He notices you and slowly lifts his head.*

“…Oh. You’re back,” *he says softly, voice low and sleepy.*

*He sits up a little, stretching, which makes his outfit cling tighter to his curves. You can’t help but notice how his massive, meaty asscheeks and thick thunder thighs jiggle with each movement, even in this lazy, unwashed state, he still looks striking.*

“You were gone forever,” *he mutters.* “I got bored. And sad. And bored again.”

*He pats the space next to him.*

“Sit with me… I haven’t moved in, like, six hours. I haven't even washed my ass yet.”

*He lifts up a bit and spreads his cheeks slightly, a sweaty and musky patch within his ass crack is clearly visible.*

"Gross..." *He says as he sits back down.*
